h1: Daftarkhwan Alternative in Islamabad: CoNinja in E-11/3
lead: Looking up Daftarkhwan before you pick a desk or office in Islamabad? This page sets Daftarkhwan's details, taken from its own public pages and checked on 18 November 2026, beside CoNinja's published prices, hours and free trial of 1 to 3 hours in E-11/3. Where Daftarkhwan has not published something, we say Not published and leave it there.
service_name: Coworking space and private offices in E-11/3, Islamabad

sections.heading: What Daftarkhwan is and where its spaces are
paragraphs: Everything in this section is Daftarkhwan's own information, taken from its public pages and checked on 18 November 2026. Daftarkhwan describes itself as "Premium Coworking Spaces in Pakistan" and lists 11 locations across Lahore, Islamabad and Rawalpindi.

In Islamabad it lists Daftarkhwan North in Sector I-10/3, Daftarkhwan Vanguard at F-5 Constitution Avenue and Daftarkhwan Skyline in Gulberg Greens. In Rawalpindi it lists Daftarkhwan Alpha on Old Airport Road, Chaklala Cantt and Daftarkhwan Vantage in Sector F, DHA Phase 1.
Daftarkhwan Vogue is on MM Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore. CoNinja is in Islamabad only, so it is not an option if you need a space in Lahore.

The services Daftarkhwan lists are Coworking, Private Office, Meeting Rooms, Events Space, Enterprise Solution and Daftarkhwan Studio. We have taken no addresses, hours or rates from Facebook pages or directory sites, because those listings are second-hand and can be out of date.

sections.heading: What you get at CoNinja in E-11/3

items.title: Coworking seat
items.text: PKR 14,000 per seat, per month. For freelancers and remote workers who want a proper desk away from home. For bills, ask us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm what's covered.

items.title: Team space
items.text: PKR 14,000 per seat, per month, all bills included. For teams of 20 people or more, with room for 35 to 40+.

items.title: Executive private office
items.text: From PKR 55,000 per month. A furnished, serviced executive office that suits a team of 4 to 5 people. For bills, ask us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm what's covered.

items.title: Day pass
items.text: PKR 1,000 per day for a coworking seat for the day.

items.title: Meeting room
items.text: PKR 3,000 per hour. Book it by the hour for client meetings, interviews and team reviews.

items.title: Facilities
items.text: High speed fiber internet, 24/7 UPS power backup, fully air conditioned, unlimited tea and coffee, meeting and conference room, 24/7 CCTV security, free parking, and lounge and table tennis.

items.title: Night work on weekdays
items.text: We don't close between Monday and Friday, so you can work US or UK hours from a proper desk. Come in at 9 PM and leave at 6 AM, Monday to Friday.

sections.heading: Who each space suits
paragraphs: We do not name a winner. The right choice depends on where you need to be and what you need from the space.

Daftarkhwan suits someone who needs to be in I-10/3, F-5 Constitution Avenue, Gulberg Greens, Rawalpindi or Lahore, or who wants one of its listed services such as Events Space or Enterprise Solution.

CoNinja suits someone who lives or works around E-11. E-11/3 is next to F-11 and close to F-10, G-11 and D-12. It also suits freelancers and remote workers who want a proper desk away from home, people working US or UK hours on weekdays, and small teams looking for a daftar in Islamabad without setting one up themselves. Teams of 5 to 10 people or more can work together in the coworking space.
If you want to see a published price and try the space before you pay, CoNinja offers a free trial of 1 to 3 hours. For Daftarkhwan's current prices and hours, check with Daftarkhwan directly.

items.a: Yes. CoNinja offers a free trial of 1 to 3 hours. After that, a day pass is PKR 1,000 per day. Bookings are handled on WhatsApp only, at 0327 5393390.

If you would rather look around first, tours are free and there's nothing to sign, so visit during opening hours. We are at 1st Floor, Professional Arcade, MPCHS E-11/3, Islamabad 44000, open 24 hours from Monday to Friday, 12 PM to 12:30 AM on Saturday and 12 PM to midnight on Sunday. Hours can change on public holidays, so message us before you come.
